components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary action button for key flows and submission.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #8A3DFF; color: #FFFFFF; font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif; font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 700; height: 44px; padding: 0.6rem 1.5rem; border: none; border-radius: 10px; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(138, 61, 255, 0.3); transition: all 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #6E30E8; transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(138, 61, 255, 0.45); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action button for filters and modal cancellations.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02); color: #F1F5F9; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08); font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 700; height: 42px; padding: 0.6rem 1rem; border-radius: 10px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { border-color: #8A3DFF; color: #FFFFFF; background: rgba(138, 61, 255, 0.12); }

components.name: Glass Card
components.description: Fundamental surface container for metrics and timelines.
components.css: .ds-glass-card { background: rgba(18, 11, 33, 0.70); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08); border-radius: 16px; padding: 1.75rem; backdrop-filter: blur(16px); box-shadow: 0 20px 40px -15px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6), 0 0 0 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05); transition: transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1); } .ds-glass-card:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-label { font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 800; color: #94A3B8; letter-spacing: 0.15em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-metric { font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif; font-size: 1.8rem; font-weight: 800; color: #FFFFFF; margin-top: 0.5rem; }

components.name: Running Status Indicator
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; color: #94A3B8; } .ds-pulse-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: #00FA9A; box-shadow: 0 0 10px #00FA9A; } .ds-status-text { font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.05em; }

narrative.northStar: Chronos Orbit: Purple Obsidian & Neon Radiance
narrative.overview: atracker presents a precision high-density operational telemetry cockpit designed for developers, systems thinkers, and power users. Inspired by high-end quantitative trading consoles and wealth management interfaces, the visual world pairs deep, atmospheric obsidian purple backgrounds with luminous, high-contrast neon accents.
keyCharacteristics: Atmospheric Obsidian Depth: Deep purple-black canvas with layered translucent glass cards.
Luminescent Accent Hierarchy: Purpose-driven neon accents (Purple for actions, Cyan for metrics, Mint for status).
Bimodal Platform Cohesion: Shared aesthetic across Desktop Web and Android Compose.
Glanceable Telemetry Density: Tabular figures, monospace timestamps, and clear categorization badges.

rules.name: The Tracking Green Rule
rules.body: Neon Mint (#00FA9A) is strictly reserved for the live status of the daemon and active tracking.

rules.name: The Glass Perimeter Rule
rules.body: Translucent glass cards must always pair with a subtle 1px border and ambient backdrop blur.

rules.name: The Tabular Time Rule
rules.body: All durations, timestamps, and percentages must render with monospace tabular numbers.

rules.name: The Tonal Layering Rule
rules.body: Depth is created through surface opacities rather than opaque gray steps.

dos: Do use font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums for all real-time counters and durations.
Do wrap every glassmorphic panel in a 1px border and backdrop blur.
Do reserve Neon Mint exclusively for active watcher and positive tracking states.
Do maintain 48×48dp minimum touch targets on Android and mobile web controls.
donts: Don't use opaque muddy gray backgrounds; always tint dark backgrounds with subtle obsidian purple.
Don't mix multiple conflicting saturated colors in the same metric card.
Don't let live WebSocket metric updates cause horizontal layout shifts.
Don't ship phone-sized bottom navigation bars to wide desktop monitors or tablet viewports.
